sections.name: Mahindra XUV400
lines: The Mahindra X U V four hundred, launched in 2023, was Mahindra's first electric SUV.
It is based on the X U V three hundred, but longer, with a bigger boot.
Two battery options. Thirty four point five, and thirty nine point four kilowatt hours.
The bigger battery has a claimed range of up to four hundred and fifty six kilometres.
With a hundred and fifty P S and three hundred and ten newton metres, it is properly quick.
The boot holds three hundred and seventy eight litres, big for this size.
Drive modes called fun, fast and fearless, plus one pedal driving with strong regeneration.
A quick, practical electric SUV, with plenty of punch for the money.
